font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Extended Data Figure 2a | Sign-constrained baseline-modulation curves

text.style: font-size: 7.3px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #56616f

g.text: Each robust curve is anchored at (0,0): the red branch is non-negative and the blue branch non-positive, so the two fits cannot cross.

text.style: font-size: 6.7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #4f5964

g.text: Independent trial halves estimate baseline and cue modulation. The sign-preserving model is y = +/-a log(1 + baseline/tau), with positive a and tau fit by robust soft-L1 loss. Source data report five-fold RMSE and

text.style: font-size: 6.7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #4f5964

g.text: bootstrap amplitude intervals. This descriptive fit does not imply that baseline firing causes cue modulation.
